title: Live Transcript Streaming During Recording
requirements: Replace the placeholder "Live transcript will appear here…" with the static message "Recording… transcription will start when you stop" displayed during recording
After stop(), the final transcript from service.transcribe replaces the deferred-message in the transcript area
acceptance_criteria: During recording the transcript area shows "Recording… transcription will start when you stop" — non-empty and explicit
The final transcript appears after stop within the pipeline completion window defined by transcription-post-recording-pipeline
The placeholder no longer persists after recording starts
out_of_scope: Live partial streaming during recording (Phase 2; SpeechTranscriber is full-file only in v1)
